name: agentic-sdlc
description: Agentic SDLC v2 — the AI-team product plugin. /asdlc-project scaffolds a client project with a project-scoped 4-agent team; /asdlc-adopt installs that team into an already-established repo; /asdlc-doctor checks the setup; /asdlc-memory-cleanup tidies a multi-account memory mess with the human in the loop. No hooks, no telemetry, no writes outside the project you scaffold.
